_comment: The intake reference of XX on product views. XX_EXC_INTAKE: the exceptions list shows the payment reference, feeder system and received date of the intake an exception is about (key anchor OBJECT: XX's intake check writes object type XXINTK and the intake number as object key). XX_BRK_GROUP_INTAKE: the clearing-account break group shows the feeder of the intake whose payment reference is in the assignment - the link is ambiguous by design (the assignment carries no feeder system), so the generator renders a candidates view: the value only when exactly one intake is a candidate, else blank with the marker AMBIGUOUS; pending until V110 names the released journal view's elements.
